customer_generation.prompt: Create a polished, portrait-oriented pet portrait featuring the exact same dog from reference image 1, named {dog_name}. Image 1 is the identity source of truth: preserve this dog's recognizable face, muzzle, eyes, natural ears, coat colors, markings, fur length, and age. Image 2 is the selected artwork design reference. Recreate its costume, props, color palette, artistic medium, lighting, and scene as closely as practical, adapting everything to a real dog's anatomy and proportions. Style: Comic Book Shop Owner. Design notes: colorful cardigan, comic shop. Show one complete dog with a natural canine head and body, no humans, no second animal, no text, no watermark.

source_art.prompt: A charming premium fine art portrait of exactly one golden retriever dog with natural canine body and paws, wearing a colorful loose cardigan in a cozy comic book shop. Dog seated naturally on a cushion beside shelves of colorful illustrated books without readable text. Warm window light, detailed golden fur, face and both ears fully visible with generous margins, vertical 4:5 composition, realistic dog anatomy, no people, no other animals, no logos or captions.

template_regeneration.prompt: Create one premium full-bleed pet portrait template, vertical 4:5, cinematic fine-art realism and detailed natural texture, beautifully art-directed for a framed print. Use the reference dog's natural face and markings. Exactly ONE dog in the scene. Dog face large, clearly visible, front or three-quarter view, eyes sharp; entire ears inside the image with comfortable 12% top breathing room. A real dog wearing dog-tailored costume, natural canine shoulders, chest, body and paws. NO human body, NO human hands, NO human characters, NO lettering, NO watermark, NO frame mockup. Category: Hobbies With Personality. Scene: Dog wearing a colorful knitted cardigan, sitting upright on a patterned pet bed in a cozy library setting with wooden bookshelves, fantasy-themed books, and soft natural light from a window. Medium: photorealistic, warm lighting, shallow depth of field.. Costume: colorful knitted cardigan. Natural dog anatomy under the outfit.

recipe.instruction: Match the original individual face exactly: muzzle length, skull, eye shape, ears, age and asymmetric markings. Keep the face naturally lit and attached to its own neck. Every visible animal surface must use the ORIGINAL dog coat distribution and texture, including forelegs, paws, hindquarters and tail. The erased template animal contributes no coat information. Rebuild a connected body at the original dog's breed, age and build. Fit the costume to that body. Use compact rounded canine paws with short grouped toes, no long fingers or human hands. Respect perspective and genuinely hidden limbs. Adapt the costume pose to the source dog's natural posture and limb angles where necessary for anatomical coherence. Preserve the costume, props and composition.
